entities.name: Query catalase-peroxidase
observations: 746 aa sequence with an N-terminal signal peptide-like region; predicted molecular weight 81.36 kDa and pI 9.55.
Best reviewed homologs are catalase-peroxidase 2 proteins with 64.8–66.5% identity and 95–98% query coverage.
Contains two peroxidase PF00141 domains at residues 94–400 and 459–716.
Homology supports bifunctional catalase and broad-spectrum peroxidase activity, but exact substrate specificity is not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: Catalase-peroxidase
observations: Catalase-peroxidases are heme b enzymes that catalyze both hydrogen peroxide disproportionation and peroxide-dependent oxidation of reducing substrates.
Reference proteins are reported as homodimers or homotetramers and bind one heme b per dimer.

entities.name: Heme b
observations: Heme b is the reported cofactor for the catalase-peroxidase homologs; one heme b is bound per dimer in the reference annotations.

entities.name: Hydrogen peroxide catalase reaction
observations: Overall reaction: 2 H2O2 -> O2 + 2 H2O; mapped to Rhea RHEA:20309 in reviewed catalase-peroxidase homologs.

entities.name: Peroxidase oxidation reaction
observations: General reaction: H2O2 + AH2 -> A + 2 H2O, where AH2 is an oxidizable reducing substrate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:30275 in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Secretory signal peptide
observations: The N-terminal sequence is rich in hydrophobic residues and resembles a signal peptide; homologous catalase-peroxidases have annotated signal peptides ending around residues 26–27, followed by a mature chain.
